details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> server: answer reasoning_effort levels the template rejects with 400 (#32332) The reasoning effort probe already renders every candidate level, but it dropped the ones the template raises on, so a request with such a level (e.g. max on Qwen3.8) reached the template and came back as a 500 on /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages. Keep the raising levels in reasoning_effort_rejected and reject them in oaicompat_chat_params_parse with an invalid_argument, which the server answers with a 400 listing the supported levels. Aliases and levels a template ignores are not rejected, so high on Qwen3.8 still renders as xhigh. Also trim the output_config.effort test to a single level. </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/68044159> **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12431/llama-b12431-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz) - macOS Apple
